# Scribe 0.6.5
- Ru LLM, semantic search and reranking now run through the teacher's own server. The Mac holds one relay token instead of the Cloud.ru and Yandex keys, so the same AI features work on every teacher's Mac without putting provider secrets in the app. OpenAI answers are unchanged. - Each worker keeps its connection to the relay open, so a lesson's plan and answer, or an indexing run's batches, pay the connection cost once. - Lesson rows in History no longer show turn counts; the lesson's length is on the line above the transcript button. - The lesson report drops the "Wait after questions" tile and the "Draft" label; a card says "Teacher edited" only once you have changed it. - Fewer "Explain this" pop-ups on the recording, import and settings screens, keeping the ones that answer a real question.

# Scribe 0.6.4
- A new look: every screen is dark glass over one ambient backdrop. By default the desktop shows through the window; Settings → Help & About → Appearance offers a painted violet-and-amber wash instead. - A student's page is now a persona. Goals and learning grievances stay pinned at the top; everything else files under topics that emerge from what the student talks about ("Work", "Family", "Pets"), biggest first, with no list to maintain. A later lesson that outdates a fact retires it into "Outdated" instead of contradicting it. Click a fact to read the student's own words it rests on, and open that line in the transcript from the fact's menu. Memories, Progress and Lesson history fold away and stay folded. - Scribe keeps one teacher. Choose "This Is My Voice" from a student's menu to make that voice yours; the teacher's page simply says "You". - The floating recording pill is the only recording surface. Messages and the "Still teaching?" and "Start a new lesson?" checks open inside the pill, with their answers as buttons; there are no separate notice windows. The sidebar shows a card for the lesson being recorded or saved from every screen. - Fixed: switching quickly between Record, Students and Ask could make the app slower and slower and then freeze on a student with many long memories. - The lesson page's "Saved to memory" card shows each fact under its topic, reveals the student's words on click, and opens the transcript line from its menu.

# Scribe 0.6.3
- The menu bar item opens a panel instead of a plain menu. While idle it offers Start Recording, the recording mode, and the last lesson; while recording it shows the timer, both level meters, Stop Recording, Next Lesson, and Take a Break. The menu bar icon shows the elapsed time during a recording. - Protection from false starts. A recording shorter than ten seconds is discarded and reported as "The Audio Is Too Short". A recording shorter than three minutes is saved but not transcribed until you choose Transcribe or Discard. - Errors with a name of their own use it as the alert title instead of "Something went wrong". - Ask answers, library refresh, transcript playback, and transfers between Macs are faster.

# Scribe 0.6.2
- Settings are organized into Recording, Transcription, AI & Memory, Library, and Help & About. Recording setups and app selection are more compact, and occasional maintenance and performance options expand when needed. - Manage student and teacher voice profiles from Students. Student deletion remains available with confirmation, and the archive is accessible from Lessons and Students. - Search for phrases across lessons and open matching moments at their transcript timestamps. Search respects transcript edits and hidden speakers. Titles you enter take priority over speaker-name fallbacks. - Recording safeguards can check whether you are still teaching after a quiet period, pause checks during a break, and stop and save an unanswered check. Missing audio or a sleeping Mac does not count as silence. - Meeting recording has clearer start and end handling, manual-stop suppression, and an optional prompt when participant changes suggest a new lesson. Start next lesson saves the current lesson while recording continues into a separate one. - A floating recording control keeps the timer and Stop button available above other windows.

# Scribe 0.6.1
- Transcription is faster with the same words and timings. Each 30-second window now runs the speech encoder once instead of three times, and windows in which the speaker segmentation found no speech are skipped, so a microphone track spends no time on the other person's turns. On a five-minute lesson excerpt the decode fell from 77 to 34 seconds with identical text. - A track that ends in silence no longer fails with an out-of-bounds timestamp: a word the aligner places after the audio ends is clamped or dropped instead of stopping the whole lesson. - The queue reports progress in lesson time. A lesson recorded on two tracks is still transcribed twice, but its row no longer suggests the lesson is twice as long as it is. - Ask's search by meaning is steadier in a large library: a lesson's index entry no longer changes when any student profile changes, fragments of a long turn are quoted in transcript order, the index keeps older lessons instead of forgetting them, the "Looked through…" line says how many lessons the search by meaning could not cover yet, and answers keep to a hard budget.
